recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. If the work group later wants exact Patient wording or modifier semantics on Person.deceased[x], treat that as a separate substantive tracker rather than part of FHIR-29820's already-applied date/bool and search-parameter request.
issue_request: FHIR-29820 was a Published/Persuasive PA issue asking for Person to express death as date/indicator, like Patient, for national person-index facade use cases; the resolution required a Person deceased date/bool property and a matching search parameter.
initial_application: The Person.deceased[x] element was added in commit 1bf9c6c3a6 under the related FHIR-20771 Person additions, and the FHIR-29820-tagged commit d6853ff75e added Person death-date and deceased search parameters. Later maintenance normalized the search expressions and status metadata without removing the requested behavior.
additional_context: PA January 2021 WGM minutes record that Person indexes are in FHIR scope and that FHIR-29820 was dispositioned persuasive by 6-0-0. FHIR-20771 is the same change family and explicitly states that the deceased property was approved under FHIR-29820.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. source/fhir.ini actively includes Person, source/person/structuredefinition-Person.xml defines Person.deceased[x] with boolean and dateTime choices, and source/person/bundle-Person-search-params.xml defines Person-death-date and Person-deceased search parameters.
